definition: Skill chaining is a skill discovery method in continuous reinforcement learning.
details: It has been extended to high-dimensional continuous domains by the related Deep skill chaining algorithm.
story: Picture a gambler who slowly learns which slot machines pay out, not by reading a manual but by pulling the lever. The machine is not handed the answers — it tries things, earns a reward or a miss, and slowly figures out what works. It learns the way a child learns to walk: wobble, fall, adjust, repeat. The learner writes its own textbook from consequences. That learn-by-reward loop is Skill chaining.
